{{Top}}
{{Quote|But I've used most other hand-weapons&mdash;so maybe this baby won't give me too much trouble! Maybe.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 10">[[Star Wars (1977) 10|''Star Wars'' (1977) 10]]</ref>}}
[[File:MeleeWeapons-AEG.jpg|thumb|300px|Various melee weapons]]
'''Melee weapons''', also known as '''hand-weapons''', were the first weapons developed for close combat and are among the simplest weapons of all.

==Description==
Melee weapons generally dealt bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage, depending on the design of the weapon. Some special weapons such as the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] dealt energy damage also. Although primarily used as close-combat weapons, some melee weapons such as [[Knife/Legends|knives]], [[Spear/Legends|spears]], and [[Axe/Legends|axes]] were also thrown.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Melee weapons came in all shapes and sizes. Some, such as knives, were small enough to be handheld, while other much larger weapons such as the [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] generally required two hands to use. Most melee weapons were simple enough to use without any special training, but some, such as the lightsaber, the [[Ryyk blade/Legends|ryyk blade]], and the [[amphistaff]], had unusual and exotic designs or functions which required training if the weapon was to be used proficiently.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

Also considered melee weapons were various [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] worn on the hand to increase [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] damage, such as [[combat gloves]] and [[stun gauntlet]]s.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

Melee weapons were used by [[Soldier/Legends|military personnel]] and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]], but due to their widespread availability, civilians also used them. Some societies and cultures had duels or ceremonial combat that required the use of specific weapons. Not all melee weapons were used exclusively for combat. Some were used to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] wild game, while others were used as cutting tools for slicing through underbrush or chopping down trees.

==History==
Early weapons such as [[Club/Legends|clubs]] and spears were made of wood and stone. The development of [[Metallurgy/Legends|metallurgy]] led to melee weapons being made of more durable metals such as [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]]. An important development was the inclusion of [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] and [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]] alloys, which gave weapons a resistance to lightsabers. This made dueling with these weapons possible with the lightsaber wielders prevalent in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era.

Other advancements in melee weapons produced [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]], which used ultrasonic vibrations to increase cutting power with less effort by the wielder. There was also the advent of [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] weapons such as the [[Shock stick/Legends|shock stick]] and [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]], which were primarily used to disable an opponent with non-lethal force. These weapons typically used an electric charge to incapacitate.

===Cultural weapons===
[[File:Lightsaber_vader.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]]]
Some [[Species/Legends|species]] developed their own favored melee weapons which became a part of their culture. For example, the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] used the [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaderffii]], a metal pole-like weapon.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] used [[Ryyk blade/Legends|ryyk blades]], which were curved hunting swords.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] used huge axes called [[Arg'garok/Legends|arg'garoks]]. [[Cerean/Legends|Cereans]] used [[shyarn]]s—light, curved swords employed during their ancient honor duels.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] used [[Atlatl/Legends|atlatls]] and [[Cesta/Legends|cestas]], which could also be used to hurl [[Booma/Legends|energy balls]]. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] used the [[amphistaff]], a living weapon that could transform into a spear, a staff, or a whip, and was even able to shoot [[Poison/Legends|venom]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> The [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] used the tiny but deadly [[Tehk'la blade]]s.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Various orders and organizations also had their signature weapon. The most familiar examples included the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], who extensively used the lightsaber, one of the most versatile and powerful melee weapons ever known. The ability to cut through virtually anything as well as the ability to deflect and redirect [[Blaster/Legends|blaster bolts]] made this weapon extremely deadly in the hands of a trained [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]]. Other organizations that made extensive use of the lightsaber were the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] and the [[Imperial Knight]]s.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

Aside from the lightsaber, the Sith used a variety of other melee weapons. One of these was the [[Sith sword]], a blade imbued with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] using [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. The wielder of this weapon would be able to call upon the dark side and channel it into the blade, using it to strike powerful blows.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> Other weapons used by the Sith included the [[Sith Tremor Sword]] and the [[Sith war sword]]. Most of these weapons had lightsaber-resistant properties, enabling them to duel effectively with their lightsaber-wielding Jedi enemies.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

Other Force-using organizations had their own signature melee weapons. The [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai Adepts]] used the [[Wan-shen/Legends|wan-shen]], a large, halberd-like weapon.<ref name="Jedi Academy Training Manual">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> Those belonging to the [[Order of Shasa]] used a curved sword known as a [[fira]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" /> The [[Felucian shaman]]s on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] used sword-like [[Felucian Skullblade|skullblades]].<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" />
